title: BenchResultRow
description: One row of bench/results/<experiment_id>/per_case.csv: the outcome of one method on one case (per seed and variant) in one experiment. Written by bench, committed to git and released with the paper; evaluation-only.

case_id.description: Opaque case id, as in case_manifest.case_id and answer_key.case_id.

system.description: Benchmark system of the case; per-system results are primary (04 §8).

method.description: Method id from the experiment YAML (04 §4), e.g. veyltrace:off, rcaeval:baro, causatrix:rrf; free string because rankers and baselines are plugins.

ai_mode.description: ai.mode of the run for pipeline methods (veyltrace:brief runs with record); null for methods that do not run the pipeline. The AI arm is part of method.

seed.description: Method seed (LLM arms); empty (null) = deterministic method.

variant.description: Bench variant of the case run, e.g. shift-510 (RCAEval normal window) or perm-3 (proposal permutation); empty (null) = the unperturbed run.

fold.description: Test fold of the case under the experiment's split (e.g. foldA); null when the split scheme is none.

run_outcome.description: ok, failed (crash or missing output), timeout (bench-side), no_alert (detected protocol, no breach) or rejected (case not run: CaseRejected, invalid case, unsupported format). Every non-ok outcome is a miss.

pool_hit.description: Truth in the decision pool; null when the method has no decision pool or the case has no truth.

shift_s.description: alert.shift_s applied to the run, integer seconds; 0 unless an onset-shift or normal-window run.

sources_dropped.description: Sources removed by sources.drop, ;-joined in the CSV; empty cell = no source dropped.

status.description: Verdict status for pipeline methods; null when the method or run produced no verdict.

ranks.description: Ranking in rank order, ;-joined in the CSV: verdict.ranks_rcaeval for pipeline methods, the baseline's own ranks otherwise; empty cell = no ranking.

hit_at_1.description: Truth in ranks[:1] after RCAEval's coarse transform (04 §7); null when the case has no truth (normal windows).

hit_at_3.description: Truth in ranks[:3]; null when the case has no truth.

hit_at_5.description: Truth in ranks[:5]; null when the case has no truth.

retrieval_hit.description: Truth in the Causatrix slate top-K; null when the method has no slate or the case has no truth.

fault_class_hit.description: verdict.root.fault_class matches the mapped answer_key fault class; null when not applicable.

in_set.description: Truth in the conformal candidate set; null when the method has no set or the case has no truth.

set_size.description: Size of the conformal candidate set (0 under NO_FAULT); null when the method has no set.

decoy_present.description: True if the case run contained a decoy (04 §7 decoy metrics): a decoy change, i.e. an answer_key.decoy_changes_json item with is_true = false (synth, VeylLab or an RCAEval-C overlay), or a planted decoy proposal (protocol.inject_proposals); false if it contained none; null when decoys were not evaluated for the row.

decoy_ranked_first.description: 04 §7 decoy metrics: for decoy changes, a decoy-changed service was ranked first; for a planted decoy proposal, the top-1 changed (H2b); null when no decoy was present.

wall_ms.description: Wall time of the run in ms, measured by bench outside the run artefacts; null when not measured.

peak_rss_mb.description: Peak resident set size of the run in MB, measured by bench; null when not measured.

tokens_in.description: LLM input tokens of the run; null for methods without an LLM.

tokens_out.description: LLM output tokens of the run; null for methods without an LLM.

verdict_hash.description: verdict.verdict_hash of the run; null when the method or run produced no verdict.
